attachmentReading.comment: Whether search can read each published attachment. Written by the reading job, read by editors, never public.

attachmentReading.title: Attachment reading
attachmentReading.summary: Whether search can read a published attachment
attachmentReading.description: One object per published attachment, upserted by the attachment reading job: whether OpenRegister found typed text in the file, whether OCR read it, or why neither happened. It holds no text of the file.

fileId.title: File
fileId.description: The Nextcloud file id of the published attachment.

publication.title: Publication
publication.description: The publication the attachment belongs to.

state.title: Reading state
state.description: typed: OpenRegister extracted text; ocr: OCR read the file; waiting: OCR ran and its text is not indexed yet; none: no text was found; unavailable: no OCR is installed; failed: reading failed, see the reason.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the attachment has this state, when the state alone does not say it.

updatedAt.title: Updated at
updatedAt.description: When the reading job last recorded the state.
